notes:
cer_canadas_energy_future: Canadian energy and macroeconomic projections conditional on the selected report edition and policy scenario.
  - macro-indicators: Canada-level real GDP, deflator and exchange-rate series; macroeconomic paths provide provincial transport-demand growth proxies and currency-conversion inputs.
open_energy_outlook: U.S. model assumptions for rail/marine operating-cost ratios, charger fixed costs/lifetimes and hydrogen-refueling investment/fixed costs.
  - charger_fixed_cost_ratio: Annual charger fixed operating cost assumed proportional to investment cost; the reviewed ratio is common to charger classes.
  - transport_process_lifetimes: Charging-infrastructure process-lifetime assumption applied across the represented charger classes.
dunsky_ev_charging_infrastructure: Canadian LD/MHD charging projections with reviewed port mixes, utilization and equipment/installation costs. Native costs are CAD2022 per rated charging power; final model costs use the scenario currency and price year.
nlr_alternative_fueling_infrastructure: U.S. residential L1 port cost estimate, represented by the reviewed cost midpoint and normalized to rated charging power in 2021 USD.
